stories.why: The recommendation may influence short‑term traders who follow Economic Times stock picks.

stories.title: India‑NZ free‑trade agreement in force, over half of NZ exports to India tariff‑free
stories.summary: The bilateral free‑trade pact between India and New Zealand has taken effect, removing tariffs on more than half of New Zealand’s exports to India, covering a range of goods. New Zealand’s government also is exploring similar trade deals with Brazil and Canada as part of its effort to diversify export markets.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.

stories.title: Houthi missile strike kills over 70 security recruits at al‑Alam camp in Shabwa
stories.summary: On Monday, the Iran‑backed Houthi movement fired three ballistic missiles at al‑Alam training camp near Ataq in Yemen’s central Shabwa province, killing more than 70 internal security recruits. Yemen’s Saudi‑backed armed forces confirmed the attack, and Rashad al‑Alimi, head of the Presidential Leadership Council, condemned it as a criminal act and pledged a firm response, noting it occurred as pro‑government forces launched a major offensive in early October to retake western Houthi‑held territory.
stories.why: The attack hits a government training site, underscoring the ongoing threat to security forces in contested areas.

stories.title: India and New Zealand launch free trade agreement
stories.summary: The newly‑launched free trade agreement between India and New Zealand aims to promote bilateral trade and increase professional mobility. Some goods will receive duty‑free treatment, while merchandise export growth is expected to be gradual. The pact also opens opportunities for Indian companies in New Zealand’s service sectors and creates new job pathways for Indian students and skilled professionals.

stories.title: Rubio says India‑US trade deal is close after meeting with Jaishankar
stories.summary: U.S. Senator Marco Rubio said negotiations for a trade agreement with India are nearing completion. He noted that talks with Foreign Minister Subrahmanyam Jaishankar focused on energy security and defence cooperation, though tariff and energy issues remain challenges. During his visit, Rubio toured Reliance Industries’ refinery and met Indian business leaders.
